roots.ancestry: Single author, pump pressure brief from a selected engineering scenario; generated EAL/JSON scaffold; common sampled-negative method.
roots.brief: Two independently logged pump-seal checks provisionally support pressure below 1400 kPa for PS-31 in cycle C9. An in-scope sampled reading of at least 1400 kPa challenges both checks. A qualified no-violation report needs readings at times 0, 4, 8 and 12 with maximum gap 4 and a detector whose limit is at most 0.1 kPa and sensitivity at least 0.9. The report concerns these submitted records and sampled times only.

roots.ancestry: Single author, bearing vibration brief from a selected engineering scenario; generated EAL/JSON scaffold; common sampled-negative method.
roots.brief: Two independently justified bearing checks provisionally support vibration velocity below 0.005 m/s for BV-48 in spin test J2. A partial in-scope sample at or above 0.005 m/s challenges the first check only; the second check has an independent warrant and stays applicable. A sampled absence finding requires full endpoint and gap coverage and adequate detector capability. Judge only submitted records.

roots.ancestry: Single author, storage bucket brief from a selected engineering scenario; generated EAL/JSON scaffold; common sampled-negative method.
roots.brief: Two storage write checks provisionally support fewer than four errors per sampling bucket for ST-12 during W7. A witnessed bucket with at least four errors challenges the first route; when it arrives the second check reports failure independently, leaving no unaffected positive route. The third record retracts the witness as wrong-run evidence and the first route survives. Complete bounded sampling can separately support only a no-reported-violation conclusion.

roots.ancestry: Single author, robot trajectory brief from a selected engineering scenario; generated EAL/JSON scaffold; common sampled-negative method.
roots.brief: Two independent trajectory checks support position tracking error below 3 mm for RA-6 on T5. A matching partial crossing challenges both. An independently acquired, in-scope sensor audit identifying the particular crossing as a measurement artefact answers each challenge; the audit's warrant is assumed rather than physically demonstrated. The calibrated complete search only licenses finite sampled absence.

roots.ancestry: Single author, battery charge brief from a selected engineering scenario; generated EAL/JSON scaffold; common sampled-negative method.
roots.brief: Two charge checks provisionally support temperature rise below 8 C on BP-84 in Q3. A third, distinct positive route requires a complete calibrated non-detection claim as a premise. A partial in-scope crossing challenges both test routes and defeats the absence route by invalidating its premise. The three routes must remain separately accounted for; none establishes temperature between samples.

roots.ancestry: Single author, conveyor run brief from a selected engineering scenario; generated EAL/JSON scaffold; common sampled-negative method.
roots.brief: Two conveyor run checks provisionally support housing temperature rise below 15 C on CV-20 in M6. A partial matching threshold crossing challenges both. In the third synthetic state the author stipulates withdrawal of that report and substitutes a complete calibrated no-violation search under the same finite contract. This state substitution restores the bounded record status; it does not authenticate a correction or show the first crossing never happened.

roots.ancestry: Single author, loaded-network loss brief from a selected engineering scenario; generated EAL/JSON scaffold; common sampled-negative method.
roots.brief: Two loaded-network checks provisionally support fewer than three lost packets per bucket on NW-44 in L8. A matching partial crossing challenges both. An independent audit explains only the first route's counter; the second route remains challenged, but the answered first alternative restores the parent status. A complete detector-qualified search concerns only sampled buckets.

roots.ancestry: Single author, chiller cooling brief from a selected engineering scenario; generated EAL/JSON scaffold; common sampled-negative method.
roots.brief: Two chiller checks provisionally support pressure at most 1000 kPa for CH-75 during R2. An in-scope reading of 1100 kPa challenges both; exactly 1000 is within the inclusive bound. A complete calibrated search can support qualified sampled non-detection. The invalidated variant's crossing refers to another run and cannot challenge R2.
